title: Jude and the Safehouse
premise: Casper Yarrow, a whistle-blower who has survived by shedding names and working unattributable cases, receives a meeting invitation from a handler they buried six months ago. Following it to a decommissioned safehouse in the Baltics, they find three strangers who each claim a different version of Casper's past—and a courier case containing the identity of the mole inside the agency that faked their handler's death. As the extraction flight approaches at dawn, Casper must decide whether trading the mole's identity will buy their escape or expose the found family they never meant to build. They board the flight alone, but leave the case behind with the strangers, choosing a name they finally own.
about_author: Paloma Hartwell is the pen name of a former intelligence analyst turned novelist who writes thrillers about the people history forgets to credit. She lives off-grid on the Atlantic coast, where she claims the fog is good for plot construction.

chapters.title: The Invitation from a Dead Man
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. Living quietly as 'Mara Voss' in Rotterdam, Casper receives a calendar invite from handler Elias Brandt—dead six months by official record. Against every instinct, they trace the invite's metadata to a decommissioned safehouse near Gdańsk. The beat is dread sharpened by longing: grief for the one person who ever knew all of Casper's names.

chapters.title: Three Strangers, One Face
chapters.summary: Alternating POV between Casper and 'Ines,' a forger at the safehouse. Casper arrives to find three operatives—Ines, a driver named Teodor, and a medic called Wren—who each possess a different fragment of Casper's buried history, as if someone distributed their identity deliberately. Brandt's voice on a delayed recording reveals the mole hunt. The beat is vertigo: identity as a puzzle others hold pieces of.

chapters.title: What the Case Is Worth
chapters.summary: Casper's POV, with a mid-chapter shift to the mole's. The safehouse is breached by the agency's cleanup team; in the firefight, Casper opens Brandt's courier case and finds proof the mole is the deputy director who 'buried' Brandt—and that Brandt may still be alive. The beat is betrayal curdling into resolve as dawn and the extraction flight close in.

chapters.title: The Name I Keep
chapters.summary: Casper's POV, closing with Wren's. At the airstrip, Casper trades the mole's identity to the extraction officer for the strangers' clean exits—then walks away from the flight, mailing the deputy director's file to three newsrooms. Weeks later, under a fifth name they chose themselves, Casper answers a knock: Ines, Teodor, Wren. The beat is quiet triumph—identity claimed, family kept.
